output_list.reason: The 'stake' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds an amount to the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the stakes mapping overflows.

The 'unstake' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it subtracts an amount from the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the stakes mapping overflows.

The 'deposit' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds a value to the totalSupply mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the totalSupply mapping overflows.

The 'notifyFeeAmount' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds a reward to the rewardRate mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the rewardRate mapping overflows.
